title: RPG Maker MV . When the progress is saved, the program crashes.

posts.author: kirillkrm
posts.body:
Hello
I've been working with the MV engine for several years and recently encountered an unexpected problem. Occasionally (in about 1 out of 10 cases), when the progress is saved (ctrl+S), the program simply closes. The progress is not saved. It can be very frustrating when I forgot to save progress for an hour while working on a game, and then, when I try to save it, everything crashes.
Has anyone encountered a similar problem? What can be done to eliminate it?
I use a lot of plugins in my work (mostly Yanfly), but since the error rarely appears (but it's a shame every time), it's extremely difficult to disable them one at a time and check which one might be the case.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
While the answer above is one possible cause/solution, there are several other possibilities as well.
one of them could be that you stored the project at the wrong place - I've seen everything from restricted folders, wrongly named folders to one really bad case where the user somehow redirected the project into the Steam Cloud cache (bad idea).
So if the answer above doesn't help, please tell us where you store your project (the full folderpath from drive letter to index.html)
